themes.label: AI as means for collective problem-solving
themes.definition: AI is named alongside science and technology as available means to meet global challenges, without discussion of AI specifically.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as part of 'science, technology and AI' or similar lists of resources or achievements.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that discuss specific AI uses, risks or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls to use these means wisely for planetary survival remain a passing mention unless AI-specific risks are named.

examples.quote: We have at our disposal the necessary means thanks to the prodigious growth of science, technology and artificial intelligence.

value.rationale: The single Cameroon passage (a quoted statement) mentions AI only in passing as part of the growth of science and technology offering means to address shared challenges.
